notes.0-2: 'the horse raised its head' / 'raised a monument' = lifted up or reared (reared also means lifted/set upright)
notes.0-3: 'raised the bar' = physically hoisted it or increased the height/standard
notes.1-3: 'the report raised concerns' = brought them up (mentioned) or heightened them (increased)
notes.3-4: 'the charity raised its funds' / 'raised capital' = collected money or increased the amount held

notes.0-3: 'something struck him as he walked' = an object hit him or a thought occurred to him; both senses derive from 'hit'

notes.2-3: 'the salesman changed his pitch' = changed his spiel or the tone/height of his voice

notes.0-4: 'she softened her pitch when the investors frowned' = her tone of voice or her persuasive speech

notes.1-2: 'from the boat they saw a low dark bank along the horizon' = a mass of cloud/fog or the shore; both from the 'raised mound/ridge' sense
